title: How CCC's Partner Ecosystem Gets Key Claims Data to Those Who Need it
summary: Discover how CCC connects claims data, AI, and Guidewire workflows to help insurers improve efficiency, reduce costs, and accelerate claims resolution.
body_markdown:
**By Manjaree Harwood, Senior Director, Partnerships Ecosystem & Alliances**


Auto claims involve more people, more data, and more decisions than ever. A single claim can touch adjusters, appraisers, repairers, parts suppliers, and more, plus of course, the consumer. And each of them depends on access to important details at the right moment. When systems don't talk to each other, information gets stuck. Work slows down, teams re-enter data by hand, and decisions get made with only part of the picture.


That's why connection matters.


To support insurance carriers, CCC’s solutions can connect data and technology across the claims process, to better inform teams, improve consistency, and help accelerate claims resolution.


CCC connects more than 35,000 businesses through the workflows where claims and repair decisions are made every day. The reach of this network is only part of what sets CCC apart. Further, CCC has built AI into those workflows for more than a decade, informed by a wealth of industry claims data and hundreds of millions of vehicle damage photos. With all this connecting through CCC solutions, insurers can better manage growing complexity and move work forward with confidence. Data is available to teams where they need it, when they need it.


Guidewire is one example of this ecosystem in action. Many insurers use Guidewire as their core claims system, and connecting it with CCC brings claims and repair data together in one workflow.


That’s why CCC built the new[CCC® Unified Integration Accelerator for Guidewire’s InsuranceSuite Cloud Platform](https://marketplace.guidewire.com/product/ccc-accelerator-for-unified-integration-for-claimcenter/01t3n00000SgztWAAR?tab=Media) , which incorporates Auto Physical Damage (APD), Casualty, and Subrogation integrations. With an impact **across an insurer’s organization** , the full integration* is being designed to enhance the experience that claims teams have with Guidewire ClaimCenter through intuitive user interfaces, API-based data transfers, and more. And with more **seamless** connections, CCC can help insurers **reduce costs** , **improve speed** , and **streamline tasks** that can slow down the claims process and delay resolution for consumers.


CCC is excited about this Integration Accelerator, not only because it led CCC to be recognized through **Guidewire’s Technology Partner of the Year award** , but also because we look forward to developing enhancements and updates that align with the continuously evolving needs of insurers.


As claims grow more complex, tapping into a vast ecosystem like CCC's, paired with powerful AI capabilities, becomes a competitive advantage rather than a nice-to-have. With critical data available throughout the claims process, insurers are better equipped to increase efficiency, adapt to change, and deliver better experiences for their teams and consumers.
